paite: Nuh theih mantam sang in minhoih ahoihzaw; mi pian ni sang in sih ni.
heading: Hinna Tungtang Thu Ngaihtuahnate
english: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

paite: Ankuangluina inn a hoh sang in, suunna inn a hoh ahoihzaw; huai mi tengteng tawpna ahi a; huan mihing in alungtang a angaihtuah ding ahi.
english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

paite: Nuih sang in lungkham ahoihzaw; mel lungkhamna ah lungtang kipahsak in lah a-om ngala.
english: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

paite: Mipil lungtang suunna inn ah a-om; himahleh mihaite lungtang vualnopna inn ah a-om hi.
english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

paite: Mi a ding in mihaite lasak zak sang in, mipil taina zak ahoihzaw.
english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

paite: Bel nuai a lingte puak vengvung bang in, mihai nuihna huchibang in a-om ngal a; hiai leng bangmah lou ahi.
english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

paite: Simmohna in mipil ahaisak mahmah a; thilpiak in theihsiamna asusia hi.
english: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

paite: Akipatna sang in thil tawpna ahoihzaw; lungsim a kisaktheih sang in lungsim a doh theih ahoihzaw hi.
english: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

paite: Heh ding in na lungsim in kinoh ke'n; hehna lah mihaite awm ah akhawl hi.
english: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

paite: Nidanglaite hiaite sang a ahoihzawkna aziak bang ahia? chi ke'n; hiai thu lah pilhuaitak in na dong kei hi.
english: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

paite: Pilna gouluah bang in ahoih a; ahi, amau ni mute a ding in ahoihzaw tham hi.
english: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

paite: Dangka sum kihumna ahih bang in, pilna lah kihumna ahi ngal a; himahleh theihna hoihzawkna bel, pilna in aneimi hinna ahawisak hi.
english: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

paite: Pathian nasep ngaihtuah in; ama'n akawisak sa, kua ahia bawl tang thei ding?
english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

paite: Hauhsak ni in nuamsa inla, huan vangtah ni in ngaihtuah in; mihing in anung a thil om ding amuhkhiaklouhna ding in, Pathian in khat lah adang kiang ah kihiang helhel in abawl hi.
english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

paite: Ka bangmah lou ni in hiai tengteng ka muta hi; midiktat adiktatna a mangthang a-om a, huan migilou agilou bawlna a ahinna hihsau a-om hi.
english: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

paite: Kidiktatsak lo zen ke'n; kipilsak lo zen sam ke'n; bangziak a nang kihihse ding na hia?
english: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

paite: Gilou lo zen ke'nla, hai sam ke'n; na hun tun ma a bangziak a si ding na hia?
english: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

paite: Hiai na let tinten ahoih hi; ahi huai a kipan in leng na khut kai ke'n; kuapeuh Pathian kihta lah amute tengteng a kipan hong paikhe ding uh ahi ngal a.
english: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

paite: Khopi a om vaihawmmi sawmkhat sang in mipil a ding in pilna athupizaw.
english: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

paite: Hoih hih a, khial lou, leitung ah midiktat a-om mahmah kei hi.
english: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

paite: Thu kigen tengteng leng limsak khol dah in; huchi lou in zaw na sikha in nang ahon hamsiat na za kha ding hi.
english: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

paite: Na lungtang in lah huchi mah bang in nang leng midangte na hamsiat mun chih athei ngal a.
english: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

paite: Hiai tengteng pilna in ka enchian vek a, "Ka pil ding," ka chi a; himahleh kei a kipan agamla hi.
english: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

paite: Gamlatak a thilte leh athuk petpette; kua'n amukhe thei dia?
english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

paite: Ka kipumhei a, thei ding leh zongkhe ding, pilna zong ding leh thilte ziak zong ding, gitlouhna haina ahi chih thei ding, haina lungsim kimlouhna ahi chih thei ding in ka lungtang koihkip in a-om hi.
english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

paite: Sihna sang a khazaw tuh numei, alungtang thangte leh lente hi a, akhut henna khau hi ahi chih ka muta hi. Kuapeuh Pathian lungkimsak huai nu a pan asuakta ding a, himahleh mikhial bel athang-awk ding hi.
english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

paite: Ngai in, hiai ka mukhia, thugentu in achi; thil omdantak mukhe ding in thil akhat akhat ka buk hi.
english: “Behold, I have found this,” says the Preacher, “to one another, to find an explanation

paite: Tu in leng ka zong lai a ka mu kei; pasal sangkhat lak a mitang khat ka mu, himahleh numei tengteng lak a mitang ka mu kei hi.
english: which my soul still seeks, but I have not found. I have found one man among a thousand, but I have not found a woman among all those.

paite: Ngai in, Pathian in mihing hoihtak in abawl chih, hiai kia ka mu a; himahleh bawltawm tampi azongkhia uhi.
english: Behold, I have only found this: that God made mankind upright; but they search for many inventions.”
